# tests/fixtures/ — Promoted Regression Cases

Every mismatch found by corpus replay, property tests, or fuzzing is minimized and promoted here with its triage classification (PORT-BUG / SPEC-GAP / ORACLE-QUIRK / UPSTREAM-BUG) per `docs/differential-testing.md` §7. Cases are immutable once committed; fixes are proven by re-running the whole fixture set plus the full corpus.
